people.name: Barry Cowsill
people.bio: American musician and member of the Cowsills (1954-2005)
people.extract: Barry Steven Cowsill was an American musician, songwriter and producer. He was the bassist of the musical group The Cowsills, who had three top-10 singles in the late 1960s.
highlights: Bassist for the musical group The Cowsills.
The Cowsills had three top-10 singles.

people.name: Ferid Murad
people.extract: Ferid Murad was an American physician and pharmacologist, His research demonstrated that nitroglycerin relaxes smooth muscle by releasing nitric oxide into the body. This work led to him sharing the 1998 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
highlights: Shared 1998 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
Demonstrated nitroglycerin releases nitric oxide to relax muscle.

people.name: Josh Outman
people.extract: Joshua Stephen Outman is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He pitched in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Oakland Athletics, Colorado Rockies (2012-2013), Cleveland Indians (2014), and New York Yankees (2014).
highlights: Former professional baseball pitcher in MLB.
Pitched for Oakland Athletics, Colorado Rockies.
Also pitched for Cleveland Indians, New York Yankees.
